import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int dx[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int N;
    static String[] mat;
    static String[] mat2;
    static int[][] v1;
    static int[][][] v;

    static class Node {
        int from, to, cost, flow;

        Node(int from, int to, int cost, int flow) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int Nodes;
        int[] cost, flow, p;
        List<Node> edges;
        int tot_cost, tot_flow;

        pair get_pair() {
            return new pair(tot_cost, tot_flow);
        }

        int get_flow() {
            return tot_flow;
        }

        int get_cost() {
            return tot_cost;
        }

        void clear(int n) {
            Nodes = n;
            cost = new int[n];
            flow = new int[n];
            p = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                cost[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                flow[i] = 0;
            }
        }

        void add_edge(int from, int to, int cost, int flow) {
            edges.add(new Node(from, to, cost, flow));
            edges.add(new Node(to, from, -cost, 0));
        }

        void get_path(int src, int sink) {
            clear(Nodes);
            flow[src] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            cost[src] = 0;
            int i, j, f;
            for (i = 0, f = 1; i < Nodes && f; i++) {
                for (j = 0, f = 0; j < edges.size(); j++) {
                    if (edges.get(j).flow > 0 && cost[edges.get(j).to] > cost[edges.get(j).from] + edges.get(j).cost) {
                        f = 1;
                        cost[edges.get(j).to] = cost[edges.get(j).from] + edges.get(j).cost;
                        flow[edges.get(j).to] = Math.min(flow[edges.get(j).from], edges.get(j).flow);
                        p[edges.get(j).to] = j;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void cost_flow(int src, int sink) {
            if (src == sink) {
                tot_cost = 0;
                tot_flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            }
            tot_cost = 0;
            tot_flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                get_path(src, sink);
                if (flow[sink] == 0) break;

                for (int cur = sink; cur != src; cur = edges.get(p[cur]).from) {
                    int rI = p[cur] % 2 == 0 ? p[cur] - 1 : p[cur] + 1;
                    edges.get(p[cur]).flow -= flow[sink];
                    edges.get(rI).flow += flow[sink];
                    tot_cost += edges.get(p[cur]).cost * flow[sink];
                }
                tot_flow += flow[sink];
            }
        }
    }

    static class pair implements Comparable<pair> {
        int first, second;

        pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        public int compareTo(pair o) {
            if (this.first != o.first) {
                return this.first - o.first;
            } else {
                return this.second - o.second;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        String[] a = new String[n];
        String[] b = new String[n];
        N = n;
        mat = new String[n];
        mat2 = new String[n];
        v = new int[n][n][2];
        v1 = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = br.readLine();
            mat[i] = a[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    v[i][j][0] = i;
                    v[i][j][1] = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b[i] = br.readLine();
            mat2[i] = b[i];
        }
        List<List<Integer>> vv = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n * n; i++) {
            vv.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    ini(i, j, v);
                    v1 = v;
                }
            }
        }
        get(a, vv);
        MinCostMaxFlow mcf = new MinCostMaxFlow();
        mcf.clear(4 * N * N + 2);
        int src = 4 * N * N;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            mcf.add_edge(src, i, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            mcf.add_edge(i + N * N, src + 1, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (a[x].charAt(y) != 'Z') {
                    int k = x * N + y;
                    mcf.add_edge(k, k + N * N, 0, a[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                if (b[x].charAt(y) != '0') {
                    int k = x * N + y + N * N;
                    mcf.add_edge(k, k, 0, b[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (b[i].charAt(j) != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < vv.size(); k++) {
                        if (vv.get(k).size() > 0) {
                            int x = k / n;
                            int y = k % n;
                            if (vv.get(k).get(i).get(j) == -1 || vv.get(k).get(i).get(j) > t) continue;
                            add_edge(x, y, i, j);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        mcf.cost_flow(src, src + 1);
        pw.println(mcf.get_flow());
        pw.close();
    }

    static void ini(int x, int y, int[][][] v) {
        v[x][y][0] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{x, y});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x1 = cur[0];
            int y1 = cur[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x1 + dx[i];
                int ny = y1 + dy[i];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || v[nx][ny][0] != -1 || mat[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y') continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(mat2[nx].charAt(ny)) && mat2[nx].charAt(ny) != '0' && (v[x1][y1][0] + 1 <= v[nx][ny][0] || v[nx][ny][0] == -1)) {
                    v[nx][ny][0] = v[x1][y1][0] + 1;
                    if (v[nx][ny][0] != v1[nx][ny]) q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                } else if (v1[nx][ny] == -1 || v1[nx][ny] > v[x1][y1][0] + 1) {
                    v[nx][ny][0] = v[x1][y1][0] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void get(String[] a, List<List<Integer>> vv) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            vv.get(i).clear();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i].charAt(j)) && a[i].charAt(j) != '0') {
                    ini(i, j, v);
                    v1 = v;
                    for (int k = 0; k < vv.size(); k++) {
                        if (vv.get(k).size() > 0) {
                            int x = k / N;
                            int y = k % N;
                            vv.get(k).add(v[x][y][0]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(int x, int y, int i, int j) {
        int n1 = x * N + y;
        int n2 = i * N + j + N * N;
        mcf.add_edge(2 * n1, 2 * n2, 0, 1000000);
    }
}
